text:
Use weighing scales to measure out ingredients for a recipe.

If you don't have a recipe to follow, why not try making these hedgehog bread rolls?

500g Wholemeal bread flour
7g Yeast
12g Caster Sugar
8g Salt
300g Water
25g butter
12 raisins for decoration

Instructions
1. Mix together the flour, yeast, sugar and salt.
2. Add the melted butter and milk to the mixture.
3. Leave the dough to rise in a bowl covered with a tea towel for an hour.
4. Cut the dough into six pieces. Dust a surface with flour and then roll each of the six pieces into a hedgehog shape. Make sure to add the snout by shaping one end into a cone. You can then use scissors to snip the spike shapes into its back. Use raisins to add eyes.
5. Heat the oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6.
6. Bake for 15 minutes until the rolls are a golden colour and have risen.
